column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a man of rebukes” is rendered “He who is often rebuked.”
Close to the Hebrew; “when the righteous increase” is rendered “are in authority.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man of contributions” is rendered “he who receives bribes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they seek his life” is rendered “seek his well-being.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all his spirit” is rendered “all his feelings.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָזוֹן (“vision”) is rendered “revelation,” and “are let loose” “cast off restraint.”
NKJV renders the rare word יִהְיֶה מָנוֹן (“manon,” meaning uncertain) as “as a son.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a master of rage” is rendered “a furious man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he hears the oath and does not tell” is rendered “He swears to tell the truth, but reveals nothing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will be set on high” is rendered “shall be safe.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the face of a ruler” is rendered “the ruler’s favor.”
